<div class="span12 widget-span widget-type-custom_widget" data-w="12" data-widget-type="custom_widget" data-x="0" style="">
<div class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_module" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="module" id="hs_cos_wrapper_module_15468577753791626" style=""><div class="imgtext_section imgtext_wrap">
<div class="imgtext_cover animatedParent animateOnce" data-sequence="1000">
<div class="imgtext_box imgright large-animation1 animated fadeInUpShort" data-id="1">
<div class="imgtext_left left-space" style="padding-left: 25px;">
<h2>Clean Your Emails &amp; Improve Deliverability</h2>
<div class="imgtextbox_text">Avoid the costs that come with sending to bad email accounts. Email Validation helps you better connect with your customers — and preserve your marketing spend — by catching and correcting invalid email data.</div>
